card.title: P7.07 real demo1 interior native parity evidence review

detail.body:
VERDICT: APPROVE for 29ccdbc07d89575d40ab11af0cb778779ce92be9 (baseline aa2af562), limited to the stated interior claim.

The claim: one 7x9x5 lattice plus 32 holdouts near MNI RAS (-7.75,-14.25,18.5), through boldref -> T1w -> MNI152NLin6Asym. I found no false pass. This was a fresh-context, read-only review. I did not run sbt, ANTs or docker, so the verdict depends on your queued JVM/JS gates.

What I checked:
- Hashes. I recomputed all 40 source-manifest entries and all 26 demo1_native manifest entries (2,609,134 bytes); 0 mismatches. The source-manifest.json sha256 is 5088d28f...d575a, which equals qualification.json. The original inputs match source-provenance, including both H5 files (44fba8c2..., 4903d429...) and boldref (4ef3fb34...).
- Crop. The retained crop float32 samples are bit-identical to the original slab at offsets [81,109,88] and [77,72,72], checked with h5py. The crop comes from the frozen query set with a -2/+3 voxel margin; the minimum margins are 2.15 and 2.14 voxels. Scala is compared against native outputs of the FULL original, so the crop cannot hide a failure inside the claimed patch.
- Independent re-derivation. A numpy/scipy model built from the raw original H5 files (trilinear field plus affine, stage order, LPS/RAS flip) reproduces points.tsv to 1.4e-14 for t1, 7.1e-15 for inverse and 1.4e-14 for roundtrip.
- Tolerances are not vacuous:
  - A half-voxel shift gives errors of about 0.1-0.5 mm against the 1e-6 budget.
  - A transposed scanner affine gives about 0.3 mm.
  - A half-voxel shift in the BOLD image gives about 20-37 intensity units against the 0.01 budget.
- The ordering and direction tests are non-cubic, the sform is oblique, and the typed composition refuses the wrong direction at compile time.

Findings (none blocking):
- F1 (low-medium, wording). The whole claim rests on one ~8x11x6 mm patch, and "interior" is a location choice with no stated rationale. The scenario id and README title could be read as whole-brain interior. Suggest "one declared ~8x11x6 mm interior patch" in the README and in the scenarios manifest.json description.
- F2 (low-medium, evidence). "7.11e-15 mm" and "BOLD equal" exist only as scalars in metadata.json. The crop native outputs (crop_*.mha, crop_bold_warp) are not in the fixtures; `ls demo1_native | grep -c crop_` returns 0. The original-container Scala gate covers point queries only, not BOLD resampling or coordinate ramps. Either retain those outputs or state the limit.
- F3 (low). qualification.json and logs/ are untracked at 29ccdbc0, yet the README cites qualification.json as the receipt. Commit it, or bind it by hash.
- F4 (low). Only the Faithful run exercises the volume path, so there are no image mutations. There is no explicit half-voxel or transposed-affine mutant; detection rests on the reasoning above. The field direction is diag(-1,-1,1), so an axis permutation in the direction matrix is not exercised.
- F5 (info). POINT_BUDGET 1e-6 is loose against the measured ~1e-14. It was set before the run and not tuned, but it does not establish double-precision parity.
- F6 (info). I did not verify the upstream OpenNeuro annex identities or fetch_metadata.py.

Scratch scripts (a.py, b.py) are in my session scratchpad under p707-review/.
